summary.extract.mjs: Moved the assetRefs same-site filter + path+search form into an exported sameSiteAssetRef(raw, pageUrl), used by the HTML elements (behavior unchanged) and the new header path. Added parseLinkHeader() (RFC 8288: splits only on commas outside <...> and quoted-strings, so undici's ', '-joined lines work; lower-cased param names, first occurrence wins, quoted-string unescaping; a malformed link-value is dropped alone and parsing resumes at the next top-level comma; never throws). linkHeaderPreloadRefs() keeps entries whose rel tokens (case-insensitive, quoted or not, space-separated) include preload or modulepreload, resolves each target against the page URL through sameSiteAssetRef, skips empty <> targets, and dedups within the header with dpl stripped. mergeLinkHeaderAssetRefs(assetRefs, linkHeader, pageUrl) adds a header ref only when no existing ref matches it with dpl stripped on both, and returns {assetRefs (sorted), linkHeaderRefs}.
summary.capture.mjs: The 2xx/4xx text/html branch calls mergeLinkHeaderAssetRefs(extracted.assetRefs, res.headers.get('link'), target) and records merged assetRefs plus linkHeaderRefs. It runs the same way in full and compact mode. linkHeaderRefs holds every distinct same-site preload ref the header carried (sorted), including ones already present in the HTML, and is for diagnostics only. captureAssets did not change: it fetches the merged refs from base with the same bypass rule as before. targetIsBaseHost and base did not change.
summary.compare.mjs: This is the outputs fix and nothing else. The new exported diffOutputPaths(out, scratch) sets the full copy to <scratch>/<basename of --out>. When the scratch directory resolves (path.resolve, then realpath for symlinks, after both directories are created) to the directory of --out, the full copy becomes <basename without .json>.full.json instead. main() writes the two copies to these separate paths. Comparison semantics did not change: compareManifests and compareEntry are untouched, and linkHeaderRefs is never read.
summary.selftest.mjs: rebuildHtmlEntryFromRaw now replays the entry's recorded linkHeaderRefs through mergeLinkHeaderAssetRefs. Without that, a mutated raw body of a dynamically rendered page would be flagged only because it lost its header refs. A new live check, live-link-header-preloads, confirms three things: every HTML entry has linkHeaderRefs; at least one live page sent header preloads; and each such ref is in assetRefs (compared with dpl stripped) and was fetched with a 2xx.
summary.selftest-link-header.mjs: This test makes no network calls. It exercises pure functions, runs capture() end to end with globalThis.fetch replaced by a logging in-memory stub, and runs compare.mjs as a child process on temporary manifests. It has 14 cases covering every item on the task list. 8 deliberate code mutations were run on a scratch copy, and each one is caught by at least one case: no merge, no dpl dedup, split on every comma, exact-match rel, no same-site filter, old outputs path, bypass sent to all hosts, and no within-header dedup.
